Brand statement
Care that
answers.
Every time.

Coracure is the assurance that a qualified, verified doctor will answer — quickly, in private, and with a record the patient keeps.

“The hardest part of being unwell is not knowing who to ask.”

name

Case

THE NAME
005
02 · Positioning
A clinic that
behaves like
a person.

The category default is a directory: search, scroll, hope. Coracure is fewer choices, better made. The patient is not asked to diagnose themselves before they are allowed to speak to someone.

Category
Doctor consultation platform
Video, audio and in-person, in one record.
Posture
Calm · Verified · Warm
Clinical accuracy without clinical coldness.
Promise
A healthier connection
The tagline is the positioning. Do not rewrite it.
Proof
Approved · Answered · Recorded
Every claim on this page is testable in-product.
POSITIONING
006
03 · Manifesto
Telling a stranger what is
wrong with your body
is an act of trust.

Everything Coracure designs — every verification badge, every wait estimate, every prescription and every summary — exists to honour that moment.

We do not sell access to doctors. We sell the confidence that someone qualified is already listening. Care, made answerable.

MANIFESTO
007

Nine principles

04 · The operating ground of the brand
01
Trust
Every doctor is approved by an administrator before a patient can ever see them.
02
Clarity
Fee, duration and consultation mode are stated before booking, never after.
03
Care
A symptom is not a search query. It is someone frightened at eleven at night.
04
Precision
A case is complete only when advice is finalised and the summary is submitted.
05
Calm
The interface never rushes, upsells or pressures a decision about health.
06
Dignity
A named clinician with a registration number — never an anonymous queue.
PRINCIPLES
008
07
Consistency
The tenth consultation feels exactly like the first.
08
Restraint
We ask for nothing a clinician does not need to answer well.
09
Accountability
If care falls short, the record exists and the escalation is real.
Answer quickly.
Listen fully.
Write it down.

When a design decision is contested, the principle wins.

The short form
Verified · Answered · Recorded

TERRITORY
011
07 · Essence
TrustedQuietly clinicalVerifiedWarmPrivate by defaultUnhurriedPreciseEveryday medicineDependableHuman scaleAccountableUnderstated
Each word is a room in the same clinic.

Together they set the temperature — quiet, exact, hospitable. If a piece of work cannot be described with a word on this page, it is off-brand.

ESSENCE
012

Who we serve

08 · Two sides, one standard of care
Primary
The unwell adult

25–55, urban, phone-first. Wants an answer tonight, not an appointment next week. Returns for the same doctor.

64% of consultations
Secondary
The family carer

Books on behalf of a parent or child. Needs the record, the prescription and the summary to be shareable.

24% of consultations
Supply side
The doctor

Admin-approved, never self-registered. Coracure must be the platform they are proud to have their registration number on.

The brand they practise under
✓
A doctor never browses patients, and a patient never sees an unapproved doctor. The product enforces it; the brand promises it.

019

Logo lockups

Three approved builds · nothing outside this set
01 · Mark

Avatars, app icon, favicon, patterns and any surface under 22 mm.

Square and vertical formats: social profiles, covers, signage.

03 · Wide

The primary. Headers, documents, email, uniform and collateral.

The tagline belongs to the stacked and wide lockups only. It is never set beside the mark on its own, never re-typed, and never translated.

APP · BOOKING
054

Named, verified, numbered

Product · 03 · The screen where trust is won or lost

Every doctor has a photograph, a real name, a speciality and a medical registration number. Approval, experience and fee are shown before booking — never discovered afterwards.

055
Product · 04
Say when
you can
answer.

Seven live statuses, four chosen by the doctor and three set by the system. A doctor with outstanding notes never receives a new instant request.

Doctor-controlled
Available now
Accepts instant consultation requests.
Scheduled only
Booked slots honoured; no instant requests.
Paused
A short break. Existing bookings stand.
Offline
Not visible to patients for instant care.
System-controlled
Request pending
A patient is waiting for the doctor to accept.
In consultation
Live. No second request can arrive.
Completing notes
Advice or summary outstanding — instant requests blocked.
The rule
A case is clinically complete only when advice is finalised and the summary is submitted. The product will not mark it complete on either alone.
Appointment states
Confirmed · Upcoming · Completed · Cancelled · No-show
Case states
Complete · Pending · Follow-up · No-show
